categories.gate: Verified paid-unit demand, reconciled contribution economics, capacity and incremental-return evidence justify additional resources.
Current SKU/price eligibility, contribution case, comparable paid-unit response and a governed promotional experiment support a test.

Public evidence warrants a defined investigation or observation plan before budget or product action.

interpretation: Monitor is an evidence-gathering action, not an assessment that all titles are commercially equivalent. No forced spending category or composite rank is assigned from sparse public evidence.
